scope: Proposition 3.2 (Uniform half-deck preparation) of the manuscript “Conditional permutations in a revealed switching environment” (preprints/Conditional-permutations-in-a-revealed-switching-environment-September-26-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 238 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 59a17db01074b8bb), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 7. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For all sufficiently large d, every ordered list of k ≤ n/2 distinct labels, from every deterministic starting layout, has endpoint law within n−3 in total variation of uniform ordered distinct positions after 400 sweeps.
